description: Adds a UK parking ticket (a council PCN or a private parking charge) to the person’s Untap account and runs Untap’s appeal-grounds engine. Returns the grounds that may apply, how confident the match is, the appeal route and deadline. Grounds are matched against the contravention, the location and observed_notes; with no observed_notes, only general grounds come back and the result is a possible appeal, not money owed. Requires sign-in to Untap.

appeal_url.description: Direct https URL on the notice for online appeals, or null if none.

contravention_code.description: Council contravention code, e.g. "01", "12", "MR11". Null for private tickets.

contravention_date.description: Date the contravention allegedly occurred, ISO 8601 date.

contravention_description.description: Full text of the alleged contravention as printed on the notice.

discount_deadline.description: ISO date by which the discount applies, or null if not stated.

discounted_amount_pence.description: Reduced amount in pence if paid promptly (usually 50% within 14 or 21 days). Null if none stated.

full_deadline.description: Last date on the notice for paying the full amount or lodging an appeal, as an ISO date.

has_windscreen_notice.description: True if a paper notice was placed on the windscreen. False if it arrived in the post only.

issued_date.description: Date the notice was issued or served, ISO 8601 date.

issuer_name.description: Issuer name as written, e.g. "London Borough of Camden" or "ParkingEye Ltd".

issuer_type.description: Council = local authority issued under TMA 2004. Private = on private land by a parking operator (BPA or IPC member).

keeper_notice_served_date.description: Private only: date the Notice to Keeper was served.

location.description: Street or car park name where the contravention allegedly occurred.

observed_notes.description: Short phrases from the notice or the person’s account that may support an appeal, such as unclear signs, a broken machine or a few minutes over. The appeal-grounds engine matches against these; with none, it can only suggest general grounds.

pcn_reference.description: PCN or notice reference number printed on the document.

vehicle_registration.description: Vehicle registration mark, or null if not shown.

name: add_parking_fine
title: Add a parking ticket (PCN)
